items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Now, I drummed with Lunsford's band for 14 years, and the reason I got out of the band, Uncle Sam called me.

ctx.x: I disliked that man so much, until I'm going to use the word hate. He didn't have any business butting in Lunsford's business. Lunsford politely told him, said, now, let him alone, let him alone. I'll take care of that. Say, we're together; we started out together. We're going to stay together as long as he want to stay here.

Now, I drummed with Lunsford's band for 14 years, and the reason I got out of the band, Uncle Sam called me. So I was behind my drum right over there at Camp Kilmer. I was behind my drums. I was with the Army Service Force Charlie Shavers's band, had a big band, playing troops off, playing them back off the ships and boats when they hit New York, down there at the piers
many a night, many a night.
